dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer shows all the roads in Cambridge and the street cleaning district for that road. The attribute district in the layer corresponds to the street cleaning schedule posted on the Cambridge Public Works website. This layer can be used in conjunction with the layer, StSweepDistricts to show the street cleaning districts in Cambridge at various scales.
Purpose: This polygon layer was created to show the street cleaning schedule for each street in Cambridge.
